A small<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|ruweenaberrie|Naberrie, Ruwee}}</ref> '''mountain village''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], not far from the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. The [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Ruwee Naberrie/Legends|Ruwee Naberrie]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] to [[Winama Naberrie]] in the village<ref name="Fact 90" /> in [[77 BBY]].<ref name="Fact 140">{{FactFile|140|FAM 1-2|Skywalker Family Tree}}</ref> While young, Ruwee used his skills as a builder in the village,<ref name="Databank" /> prior to joining the [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]] at the age of ten.<ref name="Fact 90" /> Winama eventually moved from the village and lived in Theed<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|II|352|Naberrie, Winama}}</ref> by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the childhood of Ruwee's daughter, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]],<ref name="Journal">''[[Star Wars Journal: Queen Amidala]]''</ref> who was born in [[46 BBY/Legends|46 BBY]].<ref name="Fact 140" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mountain village was first mentioned in Ruwee Naberrie's [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry, which was published on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="Databank" /> on [[October 23]], [[2002]].<ref name="DBDates">{{SWArchive|url=databank/news/2002/10/news20021023.html|text=Episode II: DVD Undelete}}</ref>
